title: Rabbi Abba bar Bizna
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma, chapter 5, halakhah 7: “Rabbi Ba bar Bizna, Rabbi Yasa in the name of Rabbi Yochanan,” concerning a halakhah. In Bereshit Rabbah 58:7: “Rabbi Abba bar Bizna says: It passes as merchandise.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Midrash Rabbah — TE digital Bereshit Rabbah 58:7 glosses the money described in Genesis 23:16 as “current with the merchant.” פרגמטיא נפק is rendered “it passes as merchandise,” rather than a narrative claim that merchandise went out.

Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 5:7 names Rabbi Ba bar Bizna and Rabbi Yasa in Rabbi Yochanan’s name. Bereshit Rabbah 58:7 names Rabbi Abba bar Bizna in a gloss on money current with the merchant. The rendering of פרגמטיא נפק follows that currency context; the comparison does not establish a new identity or legal ruling.
